# Accelute

> Accelute is an AI whiteboard tutor. Students ask a question and watch it draw the diagram, write the notes, and explain each step out loud, in sync.

Accelute is the product name. The marketing site is https://accelute.co/. The tutor app is https://app.accelute.co/. Contact: hi@accelute.co.

It is a student product (age 13+) for 1:1 lessons on a live whiteboard — not a team canvas like Miro, not a chatbot like ChatGPT, and not a classroom management tool.
